blocks.text: AI Security supports creating custom security policies to expand security coverage to your cloud infrastructure beyond the predefined security policies.

blocks.item: Add a new custom security policy to an existing protected cloud resource. For example, you can create a custom security policy to ensure that the Amazon S3 buckets containing sensitive data are encrypted.

Add a new custom security policy to resources that currently do not have predefined security policies. For example, you can create custom security policies to protect a new datastore in your cloud infrastructure.

blocks.text: To create a custom security policy:

blocks.item: Go to Policies & Controls > AI Posture Policies.
On the Policy page, click Add Policy.
See image.
The Create Policy page appears.
On the Create Policy page, for Select Cloud Provider, select the cloud type.
For Primary Resource Type, select the required resource (EC2 instance, RDS instance, etc.).
Build the query by selecting the required predicates.
View the list of predicates and operators
See image.
Click Test Run.
The query result is displayed.
See image.
Click Accept and Proceed.
On the Remediation page, click Add Remediation Procedure.
See image.
Enter the remediation procedure in Markdown format, then click Save.
Click Next.
On the Severity and Description page, enter the following details:
Policy Name: The name of the security policy.
Policy Description (Optional): The description of the policy.
Policy Severity: Static value signaling the severity of policy failure. The value can be Critical, High, Medium, or Low.
Policy Category (Optional): Select the threat category from the drop-down menu.
MITRE ATT&CK (Optional): Select the MITRE technique ID that must be associated with this policy.
See image.
Click Finish.

blocks.text: You can now view the policy listed on the Policy page.
